name: Ancient woodland
fact: 44,373 records from 1 provider; collector 2026-07-22; new data 2026-03-21; all data from authoritative sources.
gate: Authoritative designation geometry is a material constraint, but exact current parcel intersection and site-specific planning assessment remain required.

name: Ancient woodland status
fact: 2 status records from 1 provider; collector 2026-07-08; new data 2025-05-08; codes ASNW and PAWS; contains some MHCLG-created data.
gate: Status codes classify ancient woodland records but are not geometry, parcel relation or development-impact conclusions.

name: Ancient woodlands design surface
fact: Design stage On the platform; expected 53,636 records; monthly update expectation; related ancient-woodland and ancient-woodland-status datasets.
gate: Design expectations do not override current public dataset counts, freshness or parcel-level intersection checks.

name: Local nature reserve
fact: 1,727 records from 2 providers; collector 2026-07-08; new data 2026-06-19; contains some MHCLG-created data.
gate: Reserve geometry is constraint context; current designation, authoritative source reconciliation and exact parcel relation remain required.

name: Local nature reserves design surface
fact: Expected 2,606 records; ad hoc updates; Section 21 of the National Parks and Access to the Countryside Act 1949 referenced; no technical specification.
gate: Design metadata and legislation context do not prove current national coverage or parcel impact.

name: Listed building outline
fact: 121,057 outlines from 93 providers; collector and new-data date 2026-07-18; MHCLG-created, work in progress and not full England coverage; does not consistently show curtilage.
gate: Outline is indicative only and cannot establish legal extent, curtilage or exact canonical parcel relation.

name: Listed building specification
fact: Specification last updated 2025-08-07; listed-building outline data can be supplied as CSV, GeoJSON, GML or Geopackage and via supported services.
gate: Schema conformance supports exchange only; designation, legal extent, curtilage and parcel relation require authoritative evidence.

name: Tree preservation order
fact: 107,674 orders from 74 providers; collector and new-data date 2026-07-21; contains some MHCLG-created data.
gate: Order records require current legal status, linked documents, protected trees/zones and exact site relation before affecting permission analysis.

name: Tree preservation zone
fact: 94,023 zones from 79 providers; collector and new-data date 2026-07-22; contains some MHCLG-created data.
gate: Zone geometry must be linked to a current order and exact parcel intersection; geometry alone is not a complete legal conclusion.

name: Tree
fact: 246,206 tree records from 72 providers; collector and new-data date 2026-07-19; small-group specification development and mixed origin noted.
gate: Tree records are partial coverage and require linked current TPO, authoritative geometry and parcel/site checks.

name: Tree preservation order specification
fact: Specification last updated 2026-04-10; requires order, zone and tree datasets; order CSV and zone/tree spatial formats are supported.
gate: The three-dataset model supports ingestion but does not prove legal currency, complete authority coverage or parcel intersection.

name: Tree preservation zone type
fact: 3 records: area, group and woodland; dataset last updated 2023-09-28.
gate: Zone-type codes classify records only and are not protected geometry or legal evidence by themselves.

name: Biodiversity net gain design surface
fact: Design stage Backlog; Environment Act 2021 referenced; expected records and frequency unknown; no related dataset.
gate: Backlog metadata cannot produce a BNG requirement, baseline, metric result or parcel score.

name: Biodiversity net gain assessments design surface
fact: Design stage Backlog; Environment Act 2021 referenced; no technical specification and no useful links listed.
gate: No operational national assessment dataset exists on this surface; no site BNG conclusion can be inferred.

name: Five-year housing land supply design surface
fact: Design stage Research; expected records and frequency unknown; no related dataset or technical specification; updates note no geospatial source was found.
gate: Research-stage metadata cannot establish an authority's current five-year supply or a site's deliverability.

name: Five-year housing land supply screen/research
fact: Screen identifies local authorities as publishers, local monitoring evidence as available sources, no single national source and a data standard requirement.
gate: Local documents require current period, methodology, deliverability and site extraction; they cannot be generalized to a parcel automatically.

name: Annual position statement design surface
fact: Design stage Backlog; expected records and frequency unknown; no related dataset. An update records removal of the formal APS requirement in December 2024 with transitional arrangements.
gate: Historical or transitional APS material is not a current authority supply figure or site-level deliverability proof.

name: Ancient and veteran trees design surface
fact: Planning-considerations catalogue marks Backlog Paused; expected records and frequency unknown; no related dataset or specification; licensing-restriction tag present.
gate: No national operational dataset is available here; absence of records cannot establish absence of ancient or veteran trees.

name: Enterprise zone design screen
fact: Screen stage states no usable accurate national geometry, identifies a national PDF map with insufficient precision and says a data standard is required.
gate: Enterprise-zone existence or incentives cannot be assigned to a parcel without current authoritative geometry and local legal/order evidence.

name: Planning Data dataset catalogue
fact: Catalogue lists 56 geography, 30 category, 6 legal-instrument, 6 document, 11 organisation, 4 policy, 2 metric and 1 timetable datasets, with an England-coverage incompleteness warning.
gate: Catalogue membership shows available surfaces only; it does not certify completeness, legal currency or parcel-level applicability.
